20261121-chemistry-g08-1.material: Zvidzidzo zvisingazikanwi A neB zvakaiswa mumoto wekunze; chidzidzo A chakaratidza ruvara rweyero, chidzidzo B chakaratidza ruvara rwebhuruu-girini mukuyedza moto. Zvinhu zvesimbi zviri muA neB zviri zvipi?

20261121-chemistry-g08-2.title: ndechipi chinofanira kudonhedzwa
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye ndechipi chinofanira kudonhedzwa kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.material: Kuti utarise kuti chloride ion (Cl⁻) yasara senge chinhu chinobva pakurapa mvura yepombi ririko here, ndechipi chinofanira kudonhedzwa, uye chii chemical formula yeprecipitate chena inoumbwa?
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Kuti utarise kuti chloride ion (Cl⁻) yasara senge chinhu chinobva pakurapa mvura yepombi ririko here, ndechipi chinofanira kudonhedzwa, uye chii chemical formula yeprecipitate chena inoumbwa?
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Kana silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) iri musilver nitrate solution yaita chiitiko nechloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) iri mumvura, silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) precipitate chena isingananyungudiki mumvura inoumbwa, saka chloride ion inogona kuonekwa.
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Kana silver ion (Ag⁺) nechloride ion (Cl⁻) zvasangana, precipitate chena isingananyungudiki mumvura inoumbwa.
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.1: Equation yekuumbwa kwe precipitate: Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl↓

20261122-chemistry-g08-1.title: Kuongorora ion kwepamusoro
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Kuongorora ion kwepamusoro kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.material: [Kuongorora ion kwepamusoro] Tinoda kutarisa kuti lead ion (Pb²⁺) iri mumvura yakasviba yefekitari here. Kana potassium iodide (KI) solution yadonhedzwa, ndeipi ruvara nechemical formula yeprecipitate yakarurama?
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kuongorora ion kwepamusoro] Tinoda kutarisa kuti lead ion (Pb²⁺) iri mumvura yakasviba yefekitari here. Kana potassium iodide (KI) solution yadonhedzwa, ndeipi ruvara nechemical formula yeprecipitate yakarurama?
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.explain: Kana lead ion ($\text{Pb}^{2+}$) neiodide ion ($\text{I}^-$) zvaita chiitiko, precipitate yakasiyana uye yeyero yakajeka, lead iodide ($\text{PbI}_2$), inoumbwa.
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kana lead ion neiodide ion zvasangana, precipitate yeyero yakajeka inoumbwa.

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.title: Kana mvura ichiitwa electrolysis
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Kana mvura ichiitwa electrolysis kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.material: Kana mvura ichiitwa electrolysis ichiwedzerwa electrolyte shoma, ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo marudzi egasi anoburitswa paelectrode ye (-) neye (+) pamwe chete nereshiyo yavhoriyamu yawo?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Kana mvura ichiitwa electrolysis ichiwedzerwa electrolyte shoma, ndeipi sarudzo inoronga nemazvo marudzi egasi anoburitswa paelectrode ye (-) neye (+) pamwe chete nereshiyo yavhoriyamu yawo?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Maererano ne equation ye electrolysis yemvura, $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, gasi rehaidrojeni rinoburitswa paelectrode ye (-), apo reduction inoitika, rine vhoriyamu ye $2$, uye gasi reoksijeni rinoburitswa paelectrode ye (+), apo oxidation inoitika, rine vhoriyamu ye $1$.
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Fomula yemakemikari yemvura ndeye H₂O (maatomu maviri ehaidrojeni neatomu rimwe reoksijeni).
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.o.o0: Electrode ye (-): haidrojeni (H₂),  electrode ye (+): oksijeni (O₂),  reshiyo yavhoriyamu = 2 : 1
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.o.o1: Electrode ye (-): oksijeni (O₂),  electrode ye (+): haidrojeni (H₂),  reshiyo yavhoriyamu = 1 : 2
